Class floridianToothRecords

java.lang.Object
floridianToothRecords
public class floridianToothRecords extends Object
So what the floridianToothRecords program does is manages dental records for a Florida family, storing tooth types by Incisors, Bicuspids, and Missing. in a 3D array, and providing options to print records, extract teeth, and calculate quadratic root canal indices.

    • getValidToothRow

      private static char[] getValidToothRow(Scanner keyboard, String layerName, String memberName, int[] lengthTracker, int rowIndex)
      This method asks for and validates a row of teeth (uppers or lowers).
      Parameters:
      keyboard - Scanner for user input
      layerName - String description of the layer ("uppers" or "lowers")
      memberName - Name of the family member
      lengthTracker - Array to store the length of uppers and lowers
      rowIndex - 0 for uppers, 1 for lowers
      Returns:
      Validated array of characters representing teeth

    • printRecords

      private static void printRecords(int familySize, String[] names, char[][][] teeth, int[][] lengths)
      This method prints the family's complete teeth records with 1-based indexing.
      Parameters:
      familySize - Number of people in the family
      names - Array of family member names
      teeth - 3D array of tooth characters
      lengths - 2D array monitoring lengths of each row
